Title: Skip-to-main link
Problem: No skip link for keyboard/screen-reader users — WCAG 2.4.1 failure
Proposal: Add <a class='skip-link'> as first focusable element

Title: Shimmer loading states
Problem: No visual feedback during filter-triggered data refresh
Proposal: Skeleton/shimmer placeholders per card section during data load

Title: Empty state design
Problem: No content displayed when selected period has no data
Proposal: Illustrated empty state with message + Try a different date range guidance

Title: Error state design
Problem: API failures result in blank sections with no feedback
Proposal: Inline error alert per section: icon + message + Retry button

Title: Chart accessibility (ARIA)
Problem: Chart canvases have no screen-reader descriptions
Proposal: Add role=img + aria-label describing chart purpose and key data

Title: KPI definition tooltips
Problem: Users may not understand KPI names or threshold logic
Proposal: Info icon per KPI label with popover tooltip from BRD glossary

Title: Consistent help mechanism
Problem: No help feature exists — fails WCAG 3.2.6
Proposal: Add help icon in top nav linking to help centre / contextual guide

Title: Filter persistence
Problem: Filters reset on page refresh — user loses context
Proposal: Store last-used Period/Module in localStorage; add Reset filters button

Title: Stale bot timestamp warning
Problem: Last Bot Execution shows timestamp but no freshness context
Proposal: Add relative time (X hrs ago) + warning badge if > 8 hours

Title: Donut centre consistency
Problem: Some donuts show count and others show percentage — inconsistent
Proposal: Standardise: primary value in centre + label; secondary in legend

Title: Section quick-jump navigation
Problem: Automation section requires scrolling past overview — no fast route
Proposal: Sticky sub-nav tabs: Overview · Automation · Insights

Title: Drill-down from rejection table
Problem: Clicking module name in rejection table does nothing
Proposal: Link module names to filtered rejection detail view

Title: Nudge approver action
Problem: No in-app escalation for overdue approvals — admins must email
Proposal: Add Nudge button in side panel → sends notification to approver

Title: Export preview
Problem: Export output unknown until file is downloaded
Proposal: Show export preview modal with format selection (CSV/PDF)

Title: Dashboard summary email
Problem: Admins must log in daily to review status
Proposal: Scheduled 08:00 email with top KPIs + exceptions + dashboard link

Title: Historical comparison toggle
Problem: Cannot compare current period with previous period on same card
Proposal: Compare toggle on KPI cards showing period-over-period overlay

Title: Bot log deep links
Problem: Dashboard shows failed file IDs but no link to execution log
Proposal: Add hyperlink from file ID in side panel to bot log viewer

Title: Filter URL parameters
Problem: Cannot bookmark or share a filtered dashboard view
Proposal: Sync filter state to URL query params; Copy link button
